nodes.text: The world fades to black as the bandit's blow connects. When you awaken, your hands are bound.

nodes.speaker: Bandit Leader
nodes.text: 'Well, well. Looks like we've got ourselves a prisoner. Let's see what valuables you're carrying.'
They rifle through your belongings, taking what they want. After what feels like hours, they grow bored.

nodes.speaker: Bandit Leader
nodes.text: 'Dump 'em outside. They're not worth the trouble of keeping around.'
You're dragged to the edge of their camp and left in the dirt. Eventually, you manage to free yourself.

name: Bandit Ransom
description: Bandits demand ransom for your release

nodes.text: You wake up in a dim, damp cellar. Ropes bite into your wrists.

nodes.speaker: Bandit
nodes.text: 'You're awake. Good. The boss wants to talk about how you're gonna pay for your freedom.'

choices.text: Try to talk your way out

nodes.label: ransom_paid
nodes.text: You reluctantly hand over the gold. The bandit cuts your bonds.
'Pleasure doing business with ya. Now get lost before we change our minds.'
nodes.speaker: Bandit

nodes.label: ransom_refused
nodes.text: The bandit's face hardens. 'Then you'll work off your debt. Take 'em to the mines.'
After days of brutal labor, you finally manage to escape during a shift change.

nodes.label: charm_success
nodes.text: You spin a tale of powerful friends and terrible vengeance. The bandit's confidence wavers.

nodes.speaker: Bandit
nodes.text: '...Fine. Get out of here. But if I see you again, you're dead.'

name: Bandit's Plaything
description: Surrendering to aroused bandits - explicit content

nodes.text: You drop your weapon and raise your hands. The bandit's eyes gleam with cruel amusement.

nodes.speaker: Bandit
nodes.text: 'Now that's more like it. On your knees.'
[Scene continues based on enabled content tags...]
After having their way with you, the bandits leave you on the roadside, clothes disheveled and pride wounded.

name: Left for Dead
description: Wolves lose interest after defeating you

nodes.text: The wolf's fangs tear at your arm as you fall. Pain explodes through your body.
The pack circles you, snarling. But as you lie still, playing dead, they seem to lose interest.
One by one, they pad away into the shadows of the forest. You're left bleeding but alive.
You struggle to your feet, wounds aching. You need to find help soon.

name: Dragged to the Den
description: Wolves drag you back to their den

nodes.text: Powerful jaws clamp onto your leg. The alpha wolf drags you, helpless, through the underbrush.
You're brought to a cave mouth - the wolf den. The pack watches with hungry eyes.
Hours pass. The wolves seem to be saving you for later. When their guard slips, you might escape...

nodes.label: escape_attempt
nodes.text: When the alpha leaves to hunt, you slowly, painfully crawl toward freedom.

nodes.label: escaped
nodes.text: You slip away into the forest, heart pounding. Behind you, a howl of frustration echoes through the trees.

nodes.label: caught
nodes.text: A young wolf spots you and barks an alarm. You're dragged back, earning fresh wounds for your trouble.
Eventually, a passing hunter's horn scares the pack away. You're left battered but free.

nodes.label: fight_escape
nodes.text: With a surge of desperate strength, you kick the nearest wolf and sprint for the exit.
Teeth snap at your heels, but you burst into the daylight and don't stop running.
The slime oozes over you, its acidic body burning wherever it touches. Your vision blurs.
When you wake, you're covered in sticky residue. Your clothes are partially dissolved, but you're alive.
The slime seems to have moved on, perhaps seeking easier prey. You need new clothes...

name: Slime Embrace
description: Surrendering to slime - explicit tentacle content

nodes.text: You stop resisting, and the slime takes this as an invitation. Its body flows around you...
[Scene continues based on enabled content tags - tentacle, penetration, etc.]
When the slime finally releases you, you're left trembling and changed. Something dark stirs within...
The succubus's magic overwhelms you. Your strength fades as darkness claims your vision.

nodes.speaker: Succubus
nodes.text: 'Mmm, your essence is... exquisite. I'll leave you alive. For now. You may yet provide more entertainment.'
You wake alone, feeling hollow and changed. A dark hunger stirs within you that wasn't there before.

name: Willing Thrall
description: Surrendering to the succubus - explicit domination content

nodes.text: You lower your weapon and drop to your knees. The succubus smiles, her eyes glowing with dark pleasure.

nodes.speaker: Succubus
nodes.text: 'A wise choice, little mortal. I do so enjoy willing playthings...'
[Scene continues based on enabled content tags - domination, mind_control, corruption, etc.]
Hours later - or was it days? - you wake with dark memories and darker urges. The succubus's mark burns on your skin.
Vines wrap around your limbs, pulling you toward the massive plant's maw. You struggle helplessly.
The plant secretes a numbing pollen. Your struggles weaken as drowsiness overtakes you.
When you wake, you're on the forest floor, covered in sap. The plant seems to have rejected you as prey.

name: Willing Breeding
description: Surrendering to tentacle plant - explicit content

nodes.text: You stop fighting the vines. They seem to pulse with excitement at your compliance.
[Scene continues based on enabled content tags - tentacle, penetration, oviposition, etc.]
The plant eventually releases you, satisfied. Strange warmth spreads through your body...
Your enemies lie defeated before you. You take a moment to catch your breath and assess your wounds.
Victory is yours. You search the area for anything of value.
You turn and run, adrenaline pumping through your veins. Behind you, angry shouts fade into the distance.
When you finally stop, lungs burning, you realize you've escaped. This time.
